items.label: imprecise
items.band: Outlines an environmental issue affecting the Australian economy
items.feedback:
The student identifies climate change and outlines its features and economic impact: 'hurts farmers in Australia because of more droughts so they grow less'. That is enough to outline an environmental issue affecting the economy, though the wording is informal.
1. [Strength · Knowledge] "because of pollution" — You identify a cause of climate change, which adds a feature to your outline.
2. [Strength · Analysis] "this hurts farmers in Australia because of more droughts so they grow less" — You link the issue to a specific economic effect on Australian agriculture, which makes this an outline rather than just a naming of the issue.
Next band: 
Why not higher: Full marks awarded.
Better-answer outline:
- Name the issue: climate change from greenhouse gas emissions
- Feature: rising temperatures and more extreme weather in Australia
- Economic effect: lower agricultural output and exports
- Further effect: damage to infrastructure and higher insurance costs
